name: Question 10
problem: Find the unit tangent vector to the curve $r(t)=⟨\operatorname{cos}⁡t,\,2\operatorname{cos}⁡t,\,\operatorname{sin}⁡2t⟩$ at the point where $t=\frac{\pi }{2}.$
worked_solution:
For a curve $r(t)=⟨x(t),y(t),z(t)⟩$, the unit tangent vector $T(t)$ at the point $P(x(t),y(t),z(t))$ is given by

$$
T(t)=\frac{{r}^{′}(t)}{‖{r}^{′}(t)‖}.
$$

First, we find ${r}^{′}(t)$ and evaluate it at $t=\frac{\pi }{2}:$ 

$$
\begin{aligned}{r}^{′}(t) & =⟨\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(\operatorname{cos}⁡t),\,\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(2\operatorname{cos}⁡t),\,\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(\operatorname{sin}⁡2t)⟩ \\  & =⟨-\operatorname{sin}⁡t,\,-2\operatorname{sin}⁡t,\,2\operatorname{cos}⁡2t⟩ \\ {r}^{′}(\frac{\pi }{2}) & =⟨-\operatorname{sin}⁡\frac{\pi }{2},\,-2\operatorname{sin}⁡\frac{\pi }{2},\,2\operatorname{cos}⁡\pi ⟩ \\  & =⟨-1,\,-2,\,-2⟩\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we calculate the magnitude of ${r}^{′}(\frac{\pi }{2}):$ 

$$
\begin{aligned}‖{r}^{′}(\frac{\pi }{2})‖ & =\sqrt{(-1)^{2}+(-2)^{2}+(-2)^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{1+4+4} \\  & =\sqrt{9} \\  & =3\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we normalize ${r}^{′}(\frac{\pi }{2})$ and obtain the unit tangent vector to the given curve at the point where $t=\frac{\pi }{2}:$ 

$$
\begin{aligned}T(\frac{\pi }{2}) & =\frac{{r}^{′}(\frac{\pi }{2})}{‖{r}^{′}(\frac{\pi }{2})‖} \\  & =\frac{1}{3}⟨-1,\,-2,\,-2⟩ \\  & =⟨-\frac{1}{3},\,-\frac{2}{3},\,-\frac{2}{3}⟩\end{aligned}
$$

Question 10
?

Find the unit tangent vector to the curve r(t)=⟨cos⁡t,2cos⁡t,sin⁡2t⟩ at the point where t=π2.

a
 ⟨−13,−23,−23⟩
b
 ⟨13,23,−23⟩
c
 ⟨13,23,23⟩
d
 ⟨−13,23,−23⟩
e
 ⟨−13,−23,23⟩
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

For a curve r(t)=⟨x(t),y(t),z(t)⟩, the unit tangent vector T(t) at the point P(x(t),y(t),z(t)) is given by T(t)=r′(t)‖r′(t)‖.

First, we find r′(t) and evaluate it at t=π2:

r′(t)=⟨ddt(cos⁡t),ddt(2cos⁡t),ddt(sin⁡2t)⟩=⟨−sin⁡t,−2sin⁡t,2cos⁡2t⟩r′(π2)=⟨−sin⁡π2,−2sin⁡π2,2cos⁡π⟩=⟨−1,−2,−2⟩

Now, we calculate the magnitude of r′(π2): ‖r′(π2)‖=(−1)2+(−2)2+(−2)2=1+4+4=9=3 Finally, we normalize r′(π2) and obtain the unit tangent vector to the given curve at the point where t=π2: T(π2)=r′(π2)‖r′(π2)‖=13⟨−1,−2,−2⟩=⟨−13,−23,−23⟩
